build_VQVAE_model: build a VQVAE model with an encoder, decoder, num_embeddings, and embedding_dim
test_VQVAE_encode: test the VQVAE encode method to convert input data to token ids
test_VQVAE_decode: test the VQVAE decode method to convert token ids back to data
test_VQVAE_forward: test the VQVAE forward pass returning decoded output and codebook output
test_VQVAE_lookup: test the VQVAE lookup method to retrieve embeddings from codebook indices
